newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore shares seen falling further.
newsitem.headline: Singapore shares seen falling further.

text.p: Singapore shares could steady in early trade on Wednesday but are expected to continue their recent downward path before staging a recovery, dealers said.
The benchmark Straits Times Industrials Index (STII) hit a 25-month intraday low of 2,027.11 on Tuesday afternoon before rallying slightly to settle at 2,032.97 points, down 1.67.
"Technical support has already been broken and people are talking about 1,900, if support at 2,000 goes," said a dealer.
Dealers said the index had been dragged lower by foreign fund selling and a drop in the nearby Malaysian stock market.
Another dealer said one crumb of comfort was the fact that market volume had been a relatively light 160 million shares, indicating widespread liquidation had not occurred.
